name: Small Health Potion
description: A deep red potion with the familiar herbal smell every adventurer knows.

name: Large Health Potion
description: A more concentrated version, bottled thick to survive being jostled in a travel pack.

name: Small Mana Potion
description: A shimmering blue liquid, cool to the tongue.

name: Large Mana Potion
description: Kept in a crystal flask, used to recharge magic after the most exhausting spells.

name: Exploration Kit
description: Rope, chalk, and a well-worn map case — everything needed to press on a little longer between real rests.

name: Calming Draught
description: A strong herbal tea that slows the heartbeat amid the suffocating dark.

name: Antidote
description: A bitter white pill, trusted by dungeon healers.

name: Whetstone
description: A handheld sharpening stone — a few strokes are enough to make a blade sharp again.

name: Temporary Ward
description: A temporary charm, hastily carved on a piece of wood to soften the next blow.

name: Grave Dust
description: Finely ground bone dust from an old grave — rubbed on skin, it sets the flesh like old bone.

name: Broken Blade Fragment
description: A broken weapon fragment, still sharp, stripped down to be reforged into a new blade.

name: Rotten Flesh
description: A piece of rotting flesh reeking with a foul stench — other monsters would rather steer clear.

name: Venom Gland
description: A still-fresh venom gland, used to coat a weapon before a long encounter.

name: Venom Thorn
description: A thorn as thick as a finger — piercing a target makes the venom already in their body take hold many times faster.

name: Rat Meat
description: Dungeon rat meat, tough but strangely nutritious — the body visibly recovers after eating it.

name: Bat Blood
description: Still-warm bat blood, gulped down mid-battle to stay standing.

name: Slime Solution
description: The translucent ooze of a slime monster, strangely able to unclog the flow of magic.

name: Dragon Scale
description: A heavy dragon scale, its metallic sheen still warm from fire — enough to forge a shield for the whole party.
